title: LocalStorage Function-call via innerHTML
description: DOM-based XSS where a value read from localStorage is passed as an argument into a rendering function that assigns it to innerHTML.
objectives: Trace how the 'msg' key flows from localStorage.getItem() through the renderMessage(...) function into innerHTML.
Recognize that innerHTML does not execute injected <script> tags directly — you need an event-based gadget.
Confirm the payload persists across reloads until localStorage is cleared.
hints: renderMessage(value) assigns value straight to element.innerHTML — plain
Reset the state with localStorage.removeItem('msg') or localStorage.clear().
body:
LocalStorage -> innerHTML (function-call context)

Set localStorage.msg; it is passed through renderMessage() before reaching the DOM.
